author: Mitchell Parton
title: Target Cautiously Considers Placing Digital Screens for Ads in Stores
description: For now, brands should reach in-store guests through their phones, a Target ad leader said.
content:
Target is looking into putting digital screens in stores, but only in a way that wouldn’t disrupt the customer experience, a top ad leader said.
